_why: Live recall baseline: how many claims a real backend extracts from each
corpus source and gets past the grounding gate.
This is NOT the `verified` count in corpus.json. Those describe crafted
extractions — paraphrases, invented numbers, invalid schema — recorded to
pin the gate. A real model given the same source produces good output and
verifies more, so comparing live counts against them measures nothing.
Baselines are specific to the engine and model that produced them, and
will drift as models change. They are a tripwire for a prompt edit that
costs most of the recall, not an exact expectation.
